stories.title: Patrick Stewart dies at 86
stories.summary: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Captain Picard and X-Men's Professor X, died after a brief illness with Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia, his account announced. Ian McKellen and William Shatner led the tributes, and fans shared old "Make it so" memes.

stories.title: Ian McKellen's tribute to Patrick Stewart
stories.summary: Ian McKellen, Stewart's X-Men co-star and the officiant at his wedding, wrote that Stewart "wore his heart on his sleeve, which made him a man to rely on, to admire and in my case, love."
